scenes.title: The sign-out log
scenes.goal: Naomi wants one sealed exhibit logged out to grand jury room 3B before eleven.
scenes.outcome: Hollis refuses to log it without knowing the contents and closes the ledger; the clock starts.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is standing at the customer side of the counter; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.stage_action: Naomi sets the sealed brown packet flat on the counter beside the open ledger and lifts her hands away.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Morning, Sergeant. I need one exhibit logged out to room 3B.
beats.text_vi: Chào Trung sĩ. Tôi cần xuất một vật chứng lên phòng 3B.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: That's a court seal. Nobody brought anything like that in here.
beats.text_vi: Đó là niêm phong của tòa. Chưa ai mang thứ như vậy vào đây.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I sealed it downstairs this morning, after the inventory was finished.
beats.text_vi: Sáng nay tôi niêm phong dưới tầng hầm, sau khi kiểm kê xong.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Downstairs is my property room. Who let you in down there?
beats.text_vi: Tầng hầm là kho của tôi. Ai cho cô xuống đó?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: The same court order you signed for six weeks ago, Sergeant.
beats.text_vi: Chính lệnh tòa ông đã ký nhận sáu tuần trước, Trung sĩ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I signed for an inventory. Counting boxes. Not carrying things out.
beats.text_vi: Tôi ký cho việc kiểm kê. Đếm thùng. Không phải mang đồ ra ngoài.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Nothing's leaving the building. It goes upstairs to 3B by eleven.
beats.text_vi: Không có gì rời khỏi tòa nhà. Nó lên 3B trước 11 giờ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Then it goes in my ledger first, with what's inside it.
beats.text_vi: Vậy phải vào sổ của tôi trước, kèm thứ bên trong.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: The ledger asks for an exhibit number. Not for contents.
beats.text_vi: Sổ chỉ hỏi số vật chứng. Không hỏi bên trong có gì.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: In this room, the ledger asks what I tell it to.
beats.text_vi: Trong phòng này, sổ hỏi những gì tôi bảo nó hỏi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.stage_action: Eli watches from beside the hallway door, the small green light of his body camera steady, his face carefully neutral.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Deputy, is your camera running? I'd like it to keep running.
beats.text_vi: Phó cảnh sát, camera của anh đang chạy chứ? Tôi muốn nó cứ chạy.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: It runs the whole shift, ma'am. I don't switch it off.
beats.text_vi: Nó chạy suốt ca, chị. Tôi không bao giờ tắt.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Nobody asked you, Moreno. Stand where you're standing and stay quiet.
beats.text_vi: Không ai hỏi cậu, Moreno. Đứng yên đó và im miệng.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Exhibit number is on the tape. Forty-one dash seventeen dash A.
beats.text_vi: Số vật chứng ở trên băng keo. Bốn mươi mốt, mười bảy, A.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I can read tape. I'm asking what that seal is protecting.
beats.text_vi: Tôi biết đọc. Tôi hỏi cái niêm phong đó đang che giấu gì.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: It's protecting the contents from everyone who isn't the grand jury.
beats.text_vi: Nó bảo vệ nội dung khỏi tất cả, trừ bồi thẩm đoàn.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Grand jury. In my building, and nobody thought to tell me.
beats.text_vi: Bồi thẩm đoàn. Ngay trong tòa nhà của tôi, mà không ai báo.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Nobody is supposed to tell you. That's what sealed means, Sergeant.
beats.text_vi: Không ai được phép báo ông. Niêm phong nghĩa là vậy, Trung sĩ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Then it sits right here until somebody tells me something true.
beats.text_vi: Vậy nó nằm yên đây cho đến khi có người nói thật với tôi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: It's ten forty now. I'm expected upstairs in twenty minutes, Sergeant.
beats.text_vi: Bây giờ là 10 giờ 40. Hai mươi phút nữa tôi phải lên trên, Trung sĩ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Then you'd better start talking. Twenty minutes is all you've got.
beats.text_vi: Thế thì cô nên bắt đầu nói đi. Cô chỉ có hai mươi phút.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I'll talk. But nothing I say will be about what's inside.
beats.text_vi: Tôi sẽ nói. Nhưng không về những gì bên trong.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis closes the ledger and rests one hand flat on its cover.

scenes.title: Whose rule
scenes.goal: Hollis wants her name and her authority; Naomi gives only what the ledger needs.
scenes.outcome: Naomi agrees to show identification but not the contents; Eli is ordered to stop her if she leaves.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is standing at the customer side of the counter; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Start with your name. Everybody who signs this ledger gives one.
beats.text_vi: Bắt đầu bằng tên cô. Ai ký sổ này cũng phải khai tên.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: My name is on the court order in your file drawer.
beats.text_vi: Tên tôi có trong lệnh tòa, ở ngăn tủ của ông.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I'm not opening drawers. I'm asking you, standing at my counter.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không mở tủ. Tôi hỏi cô, đang đứng ở quầy của tôi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Naomi Bell. Evidence auditor, under contract to the federal court.
beats.text_vi: Naomi Bell. Kiểm toán viên vật chứng, hợp đồng với tòa liên bang.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Federal. So somebody downtown sent you here to count my boxes.
beats.text_vi: Liên bang. Vậy là có người trên thành phố cử cô xuống đếm thùng.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: A judge sent me. I've counted every box, and every shelf.
beats.text_vi: Một thẩm phán cử tôi. Tôi đã đếm từng thùng, từng kệ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Six weeks in my basement, and I never heard your name.
beats.text_vi: Sáu tuần trong hầm của tôi mà tôi chưa nghe tên cô.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: That was deliberate. People behave normally when nobody knows who's watching.
beats.text_vi: Cố ý cả đấy. Người ta cư xử bình thường khi không biết ai đang nhìn.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: You hear that, Moreno? She's been watching us. Write that down.
beats.text_vi: Nghe chưa, Moreno? Cô ta theo dõi chúng ta. Ghi lại đi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Write down what, Sarge? She hasn't done anything I can write.
beats.text_vi: Ghi gì, sếp? Cô ấy có làm gì đâu mà ghi.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: You write what I tell you. That's what a report is.
beats.text_vi: Tôi bảo ghi gì thì cậu ghi nấy. Báo cáo là thế.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: If you doubt me, call the grand jury clerk. Extension four-one-one.
beats.text_vi: Nếu ông nghi ngờ, gọi thư ký bồi thẩm đoàn. Số nội bộ bốn-một-một.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I don't call upstairs because a stranger hands me a number.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không gọi lên trên chỉ vì người lạ đưa số.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Then call the switchboard and ask for 3B. Same answer, Sergeant.
beats.text_vi: Vậy gọi tổng đài hỏi 3B. Câu trả lời vẫn thế, Trung sĩ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I've worked this building fourteen years. I know who belongs here.
beats.text_vi: Tôi làm ở đây mười bốn năm. Tôi biết ai thuộc về nơi này.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: You know who used to belong. Things changed six weeks ago.
beats.text_vi: Ông biết ai từng thuộc về. Sáu tuần trước mọi thứ đã khác.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: What changed six weeks ago? Go on, say it plainly.
beats.text_vi: Sáu tuần trước có gì khác? Nói thẳng ra đi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: A judge ordered an audit. That's plain. That's all I'll say.
beats.text_vi: Một thẩm phán ra lệnh kiểm toán. Chỉ vậy thôi. Tôi chỉ nói thế.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis studies her face for a long moment, jaw tight, saying nothing.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Put some identification on the counter. Then we'll see what's plain.
beats.text_vi: Đặt giấy tờ tùy thân lên quầy. Rồi xem cái gì là thẳng.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: You'll get my ID. You won't get what's under the seal.
beats.text_vi: Ông sẽ có giấy tờ của tôi. Không có thứ dưới niêm phong.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Moreno, if she walks out with that, you stop her. Understood?
beats.text_vi: Moreno, nếu cô ta mang nó ra khỏi đây, cậu chặn lại. Rõ chưa?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Stop her how, Sarge? She hasn't broken any rule I know.
beats.text_vi: Chặn thế nào, sếp? Cô ấy có phạm quy gì tôi biết đâu.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: She's breaking mine. In this room, that's the one that counts.
beats.text_vi: Cô ta phạm quy của tôi. Trong phòng này, quy đó mới tính.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.stage_action: Naomi takes a plastic ID card from her coat pocket and places it on the counter next to the packet.

scenes.title: The ID on the counter
scenes.goal: Hollis wants something on her record he can use.
scenes.outcome: Her record is clear, but Hollis keeps the card and makes her wait.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is standing at the customer side of the counter; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis picks up the ID card from the counter and holds it close to read it.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Bell. Washington address. You drove four hours to count boxes?
beats.text_vi: Bell. Địa chỉ Washington. Cô lái bốn tiếng để đếm thùng à?

beats.text_en: I drove four hours every Monday. I left every Friday afternoon.
beats.text_vi: Tôi lái bốn tiếng mỗi thứ Hai. Chiều thứ Sáu thì về.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: And slept where? Not anywhere in this county, or I'd know.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: The motel by the interstate. Room twelve. Check that too.
beats.text_vi: Nhà nghỉ cạnh đường liên bang. Phòng mười hai. Cứ kiểm tra.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Sit down over there. This takes as long as it takes.
beats.text_vi: Ngồi xuống đằng kia. Việc này mất bao lâu thì mất.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Not funny. Careful. You'd want the same if it were yours.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS

beats.speaker: NAOMI

beats.text_en: Sarge, her record's clear. Normally we'd hand back the card now.
beats.text_vi: Sếp, hồ sơ cô ấy sạch. Thường thì giờ mình trả thẻ rồi.

beats.text_en: Normally isn't today. The card stays with me until I'm done.

scenes.title: Names he shouldn't know
scenes.goal: Hollis tries to learn what the audit is about by guessing.
scenes.outcome: Every guess exposes what he fears: a quitting technician, a stalled records request, and Calvin Reed.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is seated in a waiting chair by the wall; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Let me guess. This started with Ray Pruitt, didn't it?
beats.text_vi: Để tôi đoán. Chuyện này bắt đầu từ Ray Pruitt, đúng không?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I'm not going to talk about anyone by name, Sergeant.
beats.text_vi: Tôi sẽ không nói về ai bằng tên, Trung sĩ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Property tech. Quit in August. Hired a lawyer the same week.
beats.text_vi: Nhân viên kho. Nghỉ hồi tháng Tám. Cùng tuần thuê luật sư.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: People hire lawyers for all kinds of reasons. Mostly ordinary ones.
beats.text_vi: Người ta thuê luật sư vì đủ thứ lý do. Phần lớn là bình thường.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Not Ray. Ray couldn't afford coffee. Somebody paid for that lawyer.
beats.text_vi: Ray thì không. Ray không có tiền uống cà phê. Có người trả tiền luật sư đó.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: You've thought about this a great deal, haven't you, Sergeant?
beats.text_vi: Ông đã nghĩ về chuyện này nhiều lắm, phải không, Trung sĩ?
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: A records request has sat on my desk for three weeks.
beats.text_vi: Một yêu cầu cung cấp hồ sơ nằm trên bàn tôi ba tuần rồi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Three weeks is long for a records request. Most take days.
beats.text_vi: Ba tuần là lâu cho một yêu cầu hồ sơ. Thường chỉ vài ngày.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Most aren't asking for every property log from twenty-seventeen.
beats.text_vi: Thường thì người ta không đòi mọi nhật ký kho năm 2017.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.stage_action: Eli glances from Hollis to Naomi, then down at the floor, uneasy.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: You haven't answered it. That's what three weeks usually means.
beats.text_vi: Ông chưa trả lời. Ba tuần thường có nghĩa như vậy.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I answer when I'm ready. Downstairs runs on my schedule.
beats.text_vi: Khi nào sẵn sàng tôi trả lời. Tầng hầm chạy theo lịch của tôi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: It used to. For six weeks, it ran on mine.
beats.text_vi: Từng là vậy. Sáu tuần qua, nó chạy theo lịch của tôi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Is it Pike Street? Or Delmar? Just tell me which one.
beats.text_vi: Là Pike Street? Hay Delmar? Nói tôi biết vụ nào.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I haven't mentioned a single case. You've mentioned two already.
beats.text_vi: Tôi chưa nhắc vụ nào. Ông đã nhắc hai vụ rồi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Calvin Reed. That's the one, isn't it? Somebody's crying about Reed.
beats.text_vi: Calvin Reed. Chính là vụ đó, đúng không? Có người đang kêu oan cho Reed.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.stage_action: Naomi keeps her face completely still, hands folded in her lap, giving nothing back.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Reed was nine years ago. The jury took forty minutes.
beats.text_vi: Vụ Reed chín năm trước. Bồi thẩm đoàn chỉ mất bốn mươi phút.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I'm not here to argue about any jury. Only about paper.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không đến để tranh luận về bồi thẩm đoàn. Chỉ về giấy tờ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Paper. You think paper can hurt fourteen years of my work?
beats.text_vi: Giấy tờ. Cô nghĩ giấy tờ làm hại được mười bốn năm làm việc của tôi?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Paper doesn't hurt anyone. It remembers what people did to it.
beats.text_vi: Giấy không làm hại ai. Nó nhớ những gì người ta đã làm với nó.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains seated in a waiting chair by the wall in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Sarge, maybe we just let her go up. She's expected.
beats.text_vi: Sếp, hay mình cứ cho cô ấy lên đi. Người ta đang đợi.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Maybe you just go stand in the hall if you're nervous.
beats.text_vi: Hay cậu ra hành lang đứng đi, nếu cậu lo.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: I'm not nervous. I'm only saying she's been patient with us.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không lo. Tôi chỉ nói cô ấy đã rất kiên nhẫn với mình.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Patient people are the ones you watch, Moreno. Remember that one.
beats.text_vi: Người kiên nhẫn mới là người phải để mắt, Moreno. Nhớ lấy.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: First warning
scenes.goal: Hollis takes physical control of the packet on the counter.
scenes.outcome: Naomi gives her first clear warning and explains the custody form; Hollis keeps his hand on it.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is seated in a waiting chair by the wall; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis slides the sealed packet across the counter toward himself and keeps his hand flat on top of it.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.stage_action: Naomi rises from the waiting chair and steps back to the counter.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Please take your hand off that. It isn't in your custody.
beats.text_vi: Làm ơn bỏ tay khỏi nó. Nó không thuộc quyền lưu giữ của ông.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Everything in this room is in my custody. That's my job.
beats.text_vi: Mọi thứ trong phòng này thuộc quyền lưu giữ của tôi. Đó là việc của tôi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Not this. This was sealed by order of a federal judge.
beats.text_vi: Không phải cái này. Nó được niêm phong theo lệnh thẩm phán liên bang.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Then the judge can come down and tell me so himself.
beats.text_vi: Vậy thẩm phán xuống đây mà nói với tôi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Herself. And she would, but you won't like how it goes.
beats.text_vi: Là nữ thẩm phán. Bà ấy sẽ xuống, nhưng ông sẽ không thích đâu.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: You think I scare easy? I've been in worse rooms.
beats.text_vi: Cô nghĩ tôi dễ sợ à? Tôi từng ở những chỗ tệ hơn.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I don't want you scared. I want you to hear me.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không muốn ông sợ. Tôi muốn ông nghe tôi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Go on, then. I'm listening. Moreno's camera is listening too.
beats.text_vi: Nói đi. Tôi đang nghe. Camera của Moreno cũng đang nghe.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: If that seal breaks in your hands, it can't go back.
beats.text_vi: Nếu niêm phong vỡ trong tay ông, không thể hàn lại.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Wax is wax. Anybody can buy a stick of red wax.
beats.text_vi: Sáp là sáp. Ai cũng mua được cây sáp đỏ.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: The wax isn't the point. The tape and the form are.
beats.text_vi: Sáp không quan trọng. Băng keo và phiếu mới quan trọng.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Everyone who touches that packet signs the form. Times, names, reasons.
beats.text_vi: Ai chạm vào gói này cũng ký phiếu. Giờ, tên, lý do.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: So I sign it too. Sergeant Hollis, opened for review. Simple.
beats.text_vi: Thì tôi ký. Trung sĩ Hollis, mở để xem xét. Đơn giản.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: That's exactly what it would say. Forever, on every copy.

beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Then there's nothing in there you can't just tell me yourself.
beats.text_vi: Vậy chẳng có gì trong đó mà cô không nói thẳng với tôi được.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I can't tell you. I'm warning you. Those are different things.

beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Sounded like a threat. Moreno, did that sound like one?
beats.text_vi: Nghe như đe dọa. Moreno, cậu thấy có giống không?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: It sounded like a warning, Sarge. She said it real calm.
beats.text_vi: Nghe như cảnh báo, sếp. Cô ấy nói rất bình tĩnh.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: The paper's already on the table. You're the one holding it.
beats.text_vi: Giấy tờ đã ở trên bàn rồi. Người đang cầm nó là ông.

scenes.title: Eli's line
scenes.goal: Hollis wants Eli to write a report that makes Naomi the problem.

scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is standing at the customer side of the counter; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Moreno, get your notebook out. We're writing this up right now.

beats.speaker: ELI

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Subject refused to identify contents of an unlogged item. Write that.
beats.text_vi: Đối tượng từ chối nêu nội dung của một vật chưa vào sổ. Ghi vào.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: She gave her name, Sarge. And the exhibit number. It's logged.
beats.text_vi: Cô ấy đã khai tên, sếp. Và số vật chứng. Nó đã được ghi.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Not in my ledger, it isn't. So it's unlogged. Write it.
beats.text_vi: Không có trong sổ của tôi. Tức là chưa ghi. Ghi vào.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: I can write that she asked to log it. That's true.
beats.text_vi: Tôi ghi được là cô ấy đã yêu cầu ghi sổ. Đó là sự thật.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: You've been here six months. You don't decide what happened, son.
beats.text_vi: Cậu mới sáu tháng. Cậu không quyết định chuyện gì đã xảy ra, nhóc.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: The camera decides, Sarge. That's what you told us in training.
beats.text_vi: Camera quyết định, sếp. Sếp dạy chúng tôi vậy.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis turns slowly to look at Eli, surprised, his mouth tightening.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I told you a lot. Pick the parts that help you.
beats.text_vi: Tôi dạy nhiều thứ. Chọn phần nào có lợi cho cậu.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Deputy Moreno. You don't have to write anything you didn't see.
beats.text_vi: Phó cảnh sát Moreno. Anh không phải ghi điều anh không thấy.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Ma'am, with respect, please let me handle my own sergeant.
beats.text_vi: Thưa chị, xin phép, để tôi tự lo với sếp của tôi.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Fair. Then I'll ask one thing. Please don't stop that camera.
beats.text_vi: Được. Vậy tôi chỉ xin một điều. Đừng tắt camera.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: I already told you. It runs the whole shift. That's policy.
beats.text_vi: Tôi nói rồi. Nó chạy suốt ca. Đó là quy định.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Policy. You both love policy until it's your name on something.
beats.text_vi: Quy định. Hai người mê quy định cho đến khi tên mình dính vào.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I'd like my identification back now, Sergeant. You've checked it.
beats.text_vi: Giờ tôi muốn lấy lại giấy tờ, Trung sĩ. Ông kiểm tra xong rồi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: You'll get it back when that packet's logged properly.
beats.text_vi: Cô sẽ lấy lại khi gói đó được ghi sổ đàng hoàng.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Then write it in properly. Exhibit number, time, my signature, done.
beats.text_vi: Vậy ghi cho đúng. Số vật chứng, giờ, chữ ký của tôi, xong.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: And contents. My ledger has a contents column. Always has.
beats.text_vi: Và nội dung. Sổ của tôi có cột nội dung. Từ trước tới giờ vẫn có.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Your ledger has a column for sealed items too. Page one.
beats.text_vi: Sổ của ông cũng có cột cho vật niêm phong. Trang một.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: She's right, Sarge. There's a sealed column. I've seen it used.
beats.text_vi: Cô ấy đúng, sếp. Có cột niêm phong. Tôi thấy từng dùng.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Moreno, one more word and you're working nights till Christmas.
beats.text_vi: Moreno, nói thêm một chữ là cậu trực đêm tới Giáng sinh.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Yes, Sarge. But the column's still there either way.
beats.text_vi: Rõ, sếp. Nhưng cái cột vẫn ở đó, dù thế nào.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Fine. Then the seal comes off, and the column won't matter.
beats.text_vi: Được. Vậy niêm phong sẽ bị bóc, và cái cột chẳng còn quan trọng.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: You say that like it's decided. It doesn't have to be.
beats.text_vi: Ông nói như đã quyết rồi. Không nhất thiết phải vậy.

scenes.title: Second warning
scenes.goal: Hollis tries to name who is behind the audit.
scenes.outcome: Naomi neither confirms nor denies, explains why she will not just walk out, and warns him a second time as he picks up the packet.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is standing at the customer side of the counter; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Who are you working for? Internal affairs? A defense firm?
beats.text_vi: Cô làm cho ai? Nội vụ? Hay công ty luật bên bào chữa?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I work for the court. I've said that three times now.
beats.text_vi: Tôi làm cho tòa. Tôi nói ba lần rồi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Courts don't send auditors for nothing. Somebody complained. Who complained?
beats.text_vi: Tòa không cử kiểm toán viên vô cớ. Có người khiếu nại. Ai khiếu nại?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Nobody complained to me. I counted. Counting doesn't need a complaint.
beats.text_vi: Không ai khiếu nại với tôi. Tôi đếm. Đếm không cần khiếu nại.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Counting what? Boxes? I count boxes every Friday. They're all there.
beats.text_vi: Đếm gì? Thùng à? Thứ Sáu nào tôi cũng đếm thùng. Đủ cả.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: The boxes are all there. That isn't what I was counting.
beats.text_vi: Thùng đủ cả. Nhưng tôi không đếm thùng.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Then what? Bags? Weights? Signatures? Just tell me what you counted.
beats.text_vi: Vậy đếm gì? Túi? Cân nặng? Chữ ký? Nói thẳng đi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.stage_action: Naomi looks at him steadily and says nothing, letting the question hang in the room.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Signatures. You were counting my signatures. That's what this is.
beats.text_vi: Chữ ký. Cô đang đếm chữ ký của tôi. Chuyện là vậy.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Guess all you like. I'm not answering any of it here.
beats.text_vi: Cứ đoán thoải mái. Ở đây tôi không trả lời câu nào.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: That's not a no. Moreno, you heard. That wasn't a no.
beats.text_vi: Đó không phải phủ nhận. Moreno, cậu nghe rồi. Không phải phủ nhận.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: It wasn't a yes. I'm declining a question you can't ask.
beats.text_vi: Cũng không phải thừa nhận. Tôi từ chối một câu hỏi ông không được hỏi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I can ask anything I want in my own records room.
beats.text_vi: Tôi muốn hỏi gì cũng được trong phòng hồ sơ của tôi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: You can ask. You can't open. That's where the line is.
beats.text_vi: Ông hỏi được. Mở thì không. Ranh giới ở đó.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Lines. Everybody's got lines for me today. Nobody's got answers.
beats.text_vi: Ranh giới. Hôm nay ai cũng có ranh giới cho tôi. Không ai có câu trả lời.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Here's an answer. It's ten fifty-two. I'm still standing here.
beats.text_vi: Đây là câu trả lời. Bây giờ 10 giờ 52. Tôi vẫn đứng đây.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I could have walked out ten minutes ago. I didn't.
beats.text_vi: Mười phút trước tôi đã có thể bỏ đi. Tôi không đi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Because Moreno would've stopped you. I told him to stop you.
beats.text_vi: Vì Moreno sẽ chặn cô. Tôi đã bảo nó chặn cô.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Because walking out breaks the chain. I don't break the chain.
beats.text_vi: Vì bỏ đi là đứt chuỗi lưu giữ. Tôi không làm đứt chuỗi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: So you need my signature. You need me. Say it.
beats.text_vi: Vậy cô cần chữ ký của tôi. Cô cần tôi. Nói đi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I need a clean record. Your signature is part of it.
beats.text_vi: Tôi cần một hồ sơ sạch. Chữ ký của ông là một phần.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis picks up the packet from the counter and turns it over in both hands, studying the seal.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Second time, Sergeant. Opening that won't end what you're afraid of.
beats.text_vi: Lần thứ hai, Trung sĩ. Mở nó ra không chấm dứt điều ông sợ.

scenes.title: What a seal is for
scenes.goal: Hollis wants to believe the seal is paperwork for lawyers.
scenes.outcome: Naomi shows him the custody form carries only her name; Eli learns that opening it cannot be undone.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I hand-carried one of these once. Federal seal. Twenty-eleven, I think.

beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Then you remember how careful everyone was. Nobody touched the seal.
beats.text_vi: Vậy ông nhớ mọi người cẩn thận thế nào. Không ai chạm vào niêm phong.

beats.text_en: The captain made me sign three times between car and courtroom.

beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Three signatures for one envelope. Did you wonder why, back then?
beats.text_vi: Ba chữ ký cho một phong bì. Hồi đó ông có thắc mắc tại sao không?
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I figured lawyers like paperwork. Lawyers always like their paperwork.
beats.text_vi: Tôi nghĩ luật sư thích giấy tờ. Luật sư lúc nào cũng thích giấy tờ.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: It's not for lawyers. It's for the accused. And the accuser.
beats.text_vi: Không phải cho luật sư. Mà cho bị cáo. Và cả bên buộc tội.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: A seal means nobody added anything, and nobody took anything away.
beats.text_vi: Niêm phong nghĩa là không ai thêm gì, cũng không ai lấy bớt gì.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: And you're telling me nobody's taken anything away from this one.
beats.text_vi: Và cô bảo tôi là chưa ai lấy bớt gì khỏi cái này.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Not since I signed it at nine. Read the form yourself.
beats.text_vi: Từ lúc tôi ký lúc chín giờ thì chưa. Ông tự đọc phiếu đi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis tilts the packet to read the custody form taped to its back, the form turned away from the camera, lips moving silently.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Bell, nine-oh-four. Bell, ten-thirty-eight. That's all it says. Just you.
beats.text_vi: Bell, 9 giờ 04. Bell, 10 giờ 38. Chỉ vậy. Chỉ mình cô.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Just me. So everything inside is exactly as I left it.
beats.text_vi: Chỉ mình tôi. Nên mọi thứ bên trong đúng như tôi để lại.

beats.text_en: Ma'am, can I ask something? What happens if somebody opens it?
beats.text_vi: Thưa chị, tôi hỏi được không? Nếu có người mở nó thì sao?
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Then the next line on that form gets their name.
beats.text_vi: Thì dòng tiếp theo trên phiếu sẽ ghi tên họ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: And the grand jury asks why. The answer goes on record.
beats.text_vi: Và bồi thẩm đoàn sẽ hỏi tại sao. Câu trả lời vào hồ sơ.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Even if they just look? Even if they put it back?
beats.text_vi: Kể cả chỉ nhìn thôi? Kể cả đặt lại?
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: There's no straight back, Deputy. The wax breaks once. Only once.
beats.text_vi: Không có chuyện trả về như cũ, Phó cảnh sát. Sáp chỉ vỡ một lần.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: She wants you scared, Moreno. It's a performance. Don't buy it.
beats.text_vi: Cô ta muốn cậu sợ, Moreno. Chỉ là diễn thôi. Đừng tin.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: I'm not scared, Sarge. I'm trying to understand what we're doing.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không sợ, sếp. Tôi chỉ muốn hiểu mình đang làm gì.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: What we're doing is our jobs. Somebody in this room should.
beats.text_vi: Việc mình đang làm là công việc. Phải có người trong phòng này làm đi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: My job ends when that packet reaches 3B, seal whole.
beats.text_vi: Việc của tôi kết thúc khi gói này tới 3B, niêm phong còn nguyên.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: And when does my job end? When your paper says so?
beats.text_vi: Còn việc của tôi kết thúc khi nào? Khi giấy của cô bảo vậy à?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I can't answer that. I only know where mine ends.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không trả lời được. Tôi chỉ biết việc của tôi kết thúc ở đâu.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.stage_action: Hollis sets the packet back down on the counter but keeps one hand resting on it.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Eight minutes. You've got eight minutes, and so have I, apparently.
beats.text_vi: Tám phút. Cô còn tám phút, và có vẻ tôi cũng vậy.

scenes.title: Third warning
scenes.goal: Hollis decides that being seen to hesitate is worse than acting.
scenes.outcome: Naomi warns a third time and steps back; Eli notes both the time and the warning; Hollis starts to break the seal.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is standing at the customer side of the counter; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Here's what I think. You want me to be afraid.
beats.text_vi: Tôi nghĩ thế này. Cô muốn tôi sợ.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Afraid men hand things over. I've watched it for years.
beats.text_vi: Người sợ thì chịu giao nộp. Tôi xem cảnh đó nhiều năm rồi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I don't want anything handed over. I want you to stop.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không muốn ông giao nộp gì. Tôi muốn ông dừng lại.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Stop what? Asking questions in my own room? Doing my job?
beats.text_vi: Dừng gì? Hỏi chuyện trong phòng của tôi? Làm việc của tôi?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Stop before your hands do something your head hasn't decided yet.
beats.text_vi: Dừng trước khi tay ông làm điều đầu óc ông chưa quyết.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis glances toward Eli and the doorway, as though measuring who is watching him.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Moreno's watching. The camera's watching. Everyone wants to see me blink.
beats.text_vi: Moreno đang nhìn. Camera đang nhìn. Ai cũng muốn thấy tôi chùn.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Nobody wants you to blink. I'd rather you just walked away.
beats.text_vi: Không ai muốn ông chùn. Tôi chỉ mong ông bỏ đi.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Walk away and wait for a call? I've waited three weeks.
beats.text_vi: Bỏ đi rồi chờ điện thoại? Tôi chờ ba tuần rồi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Three weeks of nobody calling. Every morning, waiting for that phone.
beats.text_vi: Ba tuần không ai gọi. Sáng nào cũng ngồi chờ cái điện thoại đó.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I know. That part I'm sorry about. Waiting is hard.
beats.text_vi: Tôi biết. Chuyện đó tôi tiếc. Chờ đợi rất khó.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Don't you dare feel sorry for me. Not in my building.
beats.text_vi: Đừng có thương hại tôi. Không phải trong tòa nhà của tôi.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Sarge, please. Let her sign it out. It's not too late.
beats.text_vi: Sếp, làm ơn. Để cô ấy ký xuất đi. Chưa muộn đâu.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Right is me knowing what's coming before it lands.
beats.text_vi: Đúng là khi tôi biết trước chuyện gì sắp tới.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: This is the third time I'm saying it. Don't open that.
beats.text_vi: Lần thứ ba tôi nói. Đừng mở nó.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Whatever you think is in there, opening it is worse.
beats.text_vi: Dù ông nghĩ bên trong có gì, mở ra còn tệ hơn.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Believe you. A stranger who spent six weeks in my basement.
beats.text_vi: Tin cô. Một người lạ ở hầm của tôi sáu tuần.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.stage_action: Naomi takes one deliberate step back from the counter and lets her hands hang at her sides.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: I won't reach for it again. It's yours now, Sergeant.
beats.text_vi: Tôi sẽ không với tới nữa. Giờ nó là của ông, Trung sĩ.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Mine. Good. That's the first thing you've said that makes sense.
beats.text_vi: Của tôi. Tốt. Đó là câu đầu tiên của cô có lý.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Moreno, note the time. Ten fifty-four. Sergeant Hollis reviewing contents.
beats.text_vi: Moreno, ghi giờ. 10 giờ 54. Trung sĩ Hollis xem nội dung.

beats.text_en: I'm noting the time, Sarge. And that she warned you.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Note whatever you want. You'll see I was right about her.

scenes.title: The seal
scenes.goal: Hollis wants to see what is coming at him.
scenes.outcome: The cover sheet names him; he denies it and asks Eli to turn off the camera; Eli refuses.

beats.text_vi: 10 giờ 54. Vật chứng bốn mươi mốt, mười bảy, A. Niêm phong bị Trung sĩ Hollis phá.

beats.text_en: Say it like a newsreader if you want. It's just wax.
