beats.text_en: Sarge? What does it say? You've gone completely white, Sarge.
beats.text_vi: Sếp? Trong đó ghi gì? Mặt sếp trắng bệch rồi, sếp.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: It's a grand jury cover sheet. Linwood County property room investigation.
beats.text_vi: Là bìa hồ sơ bồi thẩm đoàn. Điều tra kho vật chứng quận Linwood.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: The line underneath it names the subject of the investigation.
beats.text_vi: Dòng bên dưới ghi tên đối tượng điều tra.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Whose name, Sarge? Tell me whose name is on that page.
beats.text_vi: Tên ai vậy, sếp? Nói tôi nghe tên ai trên trang đó.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: It's a mistake. Somebody typed this wrong. This is all wrong.
beats.text_vi: Nhầm rồi. Ai đó đánh máy sai. Sai hết rồi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Nobody typed it wrong. I checked that line three times.
beats.text_vi: Không ai đánh sai. Tôi kiểm tra dòng đó ba lần.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Six cases. I logged thousands of bags. Thousands of them.
beats.text_vi: Sáu vụ. Tôi ghi hàng nghìn túi. Hàng nghìn.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Six where the weights changed before trial. Your signature both times.
beats.text_vi: Sáu vụ mà trọng lượng đổi trước phiên tòa. Cả hai lần đều chữ ký ông.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Signatures get copied. Anybody could have signed my name on those.
beats.text_vi: Chữ ký bị sao chép. Ai cũng ký tên tôi được.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Ray Pruitt watched you sign them. He kept copies nine years.
beats.text_vi: Ray Pruitt đã nhìn ông ký. Anh ấy giữ bản sao chín năm.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Ray. Of course it's Ray. He never could keep quiet.
beats.text_vi: Ray. Tất nhiên là Ray. Nó chưa bao giờ giữ được mồm.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Ray kept quiet nine years. That's the part that broke him.
beats.text_vi: Ray im lặng chín năm. Chính điều đó làm anh ấy gục.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Ma'am, is that why you needed it sealed? Because of him?
beats.text_vi: Thưa chị, vì thế chị cần niêm phong? Vì anh ta?
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: It's sealed because every page has to reach the jury untouched.
beats.text_vi: Niêm phong để mọi trang đến tay bồi thẩm đoàn nguyên vẹn.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Now it reaches them with one new page. His.
beats.text_vi: Giờ nó đến với một trang mới. Của ông ta.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I didn't write anything. I opened an envelope. That's all.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không viết gì. Tôi chỉ mở một phong bì. Vậy thôi.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: On camera. After three warnings. In front of a deputy.
beats.text_vi: Trước camera. Sau ba lần cảnh báo. Trước mặt một phó cảnh sát.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Moreno. Turn that thing off. Just for one minute. Off.
beats.text_vi: Moreno. Tắt cái đó đi. Chỉ một phút. Tắt.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: I can't, Sarge. You know I can't. And I won't.
beats.text_vi: Tôi không thể, sếp. Sếp biết mà. Và tôi sẽ không tắt.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: Who makes the call
scenes.goal: Hollis wants Eli to protect him.
scenes.outcome: Eli calls upstairs; Hollis is summoned and walks out on his own; Naomi asks Eli to log the opened exhibit properly.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — MORNING
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is standing one step back from the counter; HOLLIS is standing behind the records counter; ELI is standing beside the hallway door. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis stands motionless behind the counter, staring down at the opened packet, both hands flat on the counter edge.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Reed. Calvin Reed is one of the six, isn't he?
beats.text_vi: Reed. Calvin Reed là một trong sáu vụ, đúng không?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: He's the first of the six. Nine years in Barlow State.
beats.text_vi: Ông ấy là người đầu tiên trong sáu. Chín năm ở Barlow State.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: The bag weighed what it weighed. I wrote what was there.
beats.text_vi: Cái túi nặng bao nhiêu thì nặng bấy nhiêu. Tôi ghi những gì có đó.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: At intake it was eleven grams. At trial, it was fifty-two.
beats.text_vi: Lúc nhập kho là mười một gram. Lúc xét xử là năm mươi hai.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Eleven grams is a misdemeanor. Fifty-two was nine years. Your handwriting.
beats.text_vi: Mười một gram là tội nhẹ. Năm mươi hai gram là chín năm. Chữ viết của ông.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: You think a number on a form says who I am?
beats.text_vi: Cô nghĩ một con số trên tờ phiếu nói lên tôi là ai sao?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: No. But it tells a jury what a man did.
beats.text_vi: Không. Nhưng nó cho bồi thẩm đoàn biết một người đã làm gì.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: What happens now, ma'am? What am I supposed to do?
beats.text_vi: Giờ sao, thưa chị? Tôi phải làm gì?
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: That's your call, Deputy. Not mine, and not his. Yours.
beats.text_vi: Anh quyết định, Phó cảnh sát. Không phải tôi, không phải ông ta. Là anh.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Moreno. Eli. Listen to me. Think about your career.
beats.text_vi: Moreno. Eli. Nghe tôi. Nghĩ đến sự nghiệp của cậu.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Six months in. Make this call and nobody here trusts you.
beats.text_vi: Mới sáu tháng. Gọi cú này là không ai ở đây tin cậu nữa.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Sarge, you taught us the camera decides. It already decided.
beats.text_vi: Sếp, sếp dạy là camera quyết định. Nó đã quyết định rồi.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: I was talking about other people, son. Not about us.
beats.text_vi: Tôi nói về người khác, nhóc. Không phải về chúng ta.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: There isn't an us, Sarge. There's just what the camera saw.
beats.text_vi: Không có chúng ta, sếp. Chỉ có những gì camera thấy.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.stage_action: Eli unclips the radio from his shoulder and raises it close to his mouth.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Records to 3B. Sealed exhibit opened at the counter. Clerk, please.
beats.text_vi: Phòng hồ sơ gọi 3B. Vật chứng niêm phong đã bị mở tại quầy. Mời thư ký.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking quietly into the shoulder radio held near his mouth. No reply is audible. The other actors are silent and out of frame. No extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: They knew she was coming, Sarge. They've been waiting since ten.
beats.text_vi: Họ biết cô ấy sẽ đến, sếp. Họ đợi từ 10 giờ.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Two marshals are coming down. The clerk wants you upstairs.
beats.text_vi: Hai nhân viên tư pháp đang xuống. Thư ký muốn sếp lên trên.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing beside the hallway door in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Upstairs. Fourteen years, and I've never once been called upstairs.
beats.text_vi: Lên trên. Mười bốn năm, chưa lần nào tôi được gọi lên trên.
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: You can walk up yourself, Sergeant. Nobody has to walk you.
beats.text_vi: Ông tự đi lên được, Trung sĩ. Không ai phải dẫn ông.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.text_en: Is that a kindness? From you? After everything you've just done?
beats.text_vi: Đó là lòng tốt à? Từ cô? Sau tất cả những gì cô vừa làm?
beats.stage_action: HOLLIS remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: It's the last choice you still get to make yourself.
beats.text_vi: Đó là lựa chọn cuối cùng ông còn tự quyết được.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to HOLLIS offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: HOLLIS
beats.stage_action: Hollis walks out from behind the counter and leaves through the hallway door without looking back.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Deputy, log it with me. Opened at ten fifty-four.
beats.text_vi: Phó cảnh sát, cùng tôi ghi sổ. Mở lúc 10 giờ 54.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing one step back from the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

scenes.title: A month later
scenes.goal: Naomi returns the released exhibit; Calvin Reed comes for his property.
scenes.outcome: Eli runs the records room under a two-signature rule; Calvin signs for the belongings held for nine years.
scenes.location: LINWOOD COUNTY COURTHOUSE — RECORDS ROOM — AFTERNOON, ONE MONTH LATER
scenes.setup_en: NAOMI is standing at the customer side of the counter; ELI is standing behind the records counter. Props are preset between scenes; no other visible or audible people.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Doctor Bell. I didn't think we'd see you down here again.
beats.text_vi: Tiến sĩ Bell. Tôi không nghĩ sẽ gặp chị ở đây lần nữa.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Just one more signature. The grand jury released the exhibit back.
beats.text_vi: Chỉ thêm một chữ ký. Bồi thẩm đoàn đã trả lại vật chứng.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Two signatures now, for everything. Mine and the clerk's. New rule.
beats.text_vi: Giờ mọi thứ phải hai chữ ký. Của tôi và của thư ký. Quy định mới.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: Good rule. Sounds like somebody who learned something. Who wrote it?
beats.text_vi: Quy định hay. Nghe như người đã học được điều gì. Ai viết?
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: The oversight board. I asked them to keep the sealed column.
beats.text_vi: Hội đồng giám sát. Tôi đã xin họ giữ cột niêm phong.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: How are things here? Honestly. Not the version for the board.
beats.text_vi: Ở đây thế nào? Nói thật. Không phải bản dành cho hội đồng.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Quiet. Some people don't talk to me. Most people do, actually.
beats.text_vi: Yên ắng. Vài người không nói chuyện với tôi. Thật ra phần lớn thì có.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: And Sergeant Hollis? I heard about the indictment, not much else.
beats.text_vi: Còn Trung sĩ Hollis? Tôi nghe về bản cáo trạng, không biết gì thêm.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Suspended. His certification's gone. Trial's set for March, they're saying.
beats.text_vi: Bị đình chỉ. Mất chứng chỉ. Nghe nói tháng Ba xét xử.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: He sent me a note. Said I wrote the report right.
beats.text_vi: Ông ấy gửi tôi một tờ giấy. Nói tôi viết báo cáo đúng.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.stage_action: Naomi takes that in quietly with a small, tired nod.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: That might be the truest thing he's written in years.
beats.text_vi: Có lẽ là điều thật nhất ông ta viết trong nhiều năm.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Four of the six cases are vacated. Two more by Christmas.
beats.text_vi: Bốn trong sáu vụ đã bị hủy án. Hai vụ nữa trước Giáng sinh.
beats.stage_action: ELI remains standing behind the records counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to NAOMI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: NAOMI
beats.text_en: And Mr. Reed? I was told he'd be down here today.
beats.text_vi: Còn ông Reed? Tôi nghe nói hôm nay ông ấy xuống đây.
beats.stage_action: NAOMI remains standing at the customer side of the counter in a static medium close-up, speaking to ELI offscreen with a consistent eyeline. The other actors are silent and out of frame. Use a brief natural pause; no prop handling or extra movement.

beats.speaker: ELI
beats.text_en: Any minute. He's coming for his property envelope. Nine years shelved.
beats.text_vi: Sắp tới rồi. Ông ấy đến lấy phong bì tài sản. Nằm trên kệ chín năm.

beats.text_en: Nine years I said the weight was wrong. Nobody listened.

beats.text_en: It's written down now. In a place nobody gets to change.
